# CI End‑to‑End Test Job\n\nThis repository includes an additional GitHub Actions workflow (`e2e-tests.yml`) that runs after a successful deployment.\n\n### What it does\n1. Checks out the repository.\n2. Installs Playwright and its browser binaries.\n3. Executes a Playwright test against the URL supplied via the `SITE_URL` secret.\n4. Asserts that:\n   - The site is accessed via **HTTPS**.\n   - Page load time is **< 200 ms**.\n   - CDN caching headers (`x-azure-cache-status` or `cache-control`) are present.\n5. Publishes the raw JSON test result as an artifact (`playwright-report`).\n6. Generates a markdown summary (`reports/e2e-report.md`).\n\nThe generated report is version‑controlled and can be viewed in the repository under the `reports/` folder.\n
